terms.description: The Cities and Municipalities Competitiveness Index is a DTI-led ranking that compares local economies across several pillars.
A score for one CMCI dimension, such as economic dynamism, government efficiency, infrastructure, resiliency, or innovation.

Aparri's CMCI profile shows four pillars (25% each) for 2018-2021 and five pillars (20% each) from 2022, and some indicators were renamed or replaced. Ranks are the fairest year-to-year comparison; overall scores before and after 2022 are not directly comparable.

content.sourceNote: CMCI figures come from the DTI CMCI LGU profile pages for 2018-2024. Overall score is the sum of the pillar scores; DTI did not publish 2018 pillar scores for Aparri, so only ranks are shown for that year. Update this JSON data file when DTI publishes a new profile.
